about.tagline: Jwi lyanu. Wailesi yanu. Koonse koonse.
about.whoWeAreBody: {{appName}} nga wailesi yamazuba aano ikumuletela zibonwa za live, ma podcast aasalidwe, makani aakufwambaana, alimwi akwaanzana abawambi abibonwa mbomuyanda — koonse mu app yomwe. Nikuba mulaswiilila a live, mulazwidilizya cibalo ca podcast kunze aa intaneti, naa mulalomba lwiimbo ndomuyanda, tulipo kumujatilizya kujwi lyabukkalabo bwanu, koonse koonse nkomubede.
about.missionBody: Kwaambila, kubotezya, alimwi akwaanzania baswiilizi besu kwiinda muwailesi ya live iibotezya, ma podcast eesu lwesu, alimwi amakani aaciindi eeco — kwapedwe abubotu abusinizyo mbobayandisya baswiilizi bamazuba aano, aacintu koonse ncobasala.
